Centre to file AI-171 crash probe report in Supreme Court by October

The Central government informed the Supreme Court that the final report on the AI-171 crash investigation will be submitted in October. The Air India Ahmedabad crash probe is not an internal exercise, according to the Aeronautical Information Publication (AIP) which stated this to the court. The report will be filed before the Supreme Court.
